description: DOM steady state at a 5s interval. The hottest recurring path and the harness's canonical scenario.
metric: pass duration; reads per cycle per port; cadence jitter (sigma of inter-sweep interval)
instrument: in-process timing + call trace; last_update_time on the DUT
notes: Pass duration and reads/cycle/port run today via run_trace.sh --time and the call trace. CADENCE JITTER DOES NOT: it is a property of the scheduling loop (task_worker), and this harness drives a single pass (poll_once) so there is no inter-sweep interval to measure. Jitter needs task_worker driving, or the DUT.
excludes: link_change_fast_flag_recapture: result_4 permanently deselects test_link_change_triggers_fast_flag_recapture, so its link-change fast path is not behaviourally equivalent to the reference and must not be compared.
